identity: A draggable map with place markers, zoom controls, and task-specific tools for selecting places, dropping a pin, planning a route, or drawing a delivery zone.

scenarios.name: marker
scenarios.screen: The map shows roads, geographic features, district names, and some of roughly 20 named places. The requested place is outside the initial view; zoom controls and place search are visible, and no place card is open.
never: The requested place already selected.
A place card open.
The requested marker inside the initial viewport.

arrangements.text: The map fills the task area, with search along its top edge and zoom controls in its upper-left corner.
Search sits to the left of the map, with zoom controls in the map's upper-right corner.

scenarios.name: center
scenarios.screen: The map shows roads, geographic features, district names, and visible place markers, with a circular reticle fixed at its centre. Search and zoom controls are visible; no place is selected and no card is open.
never: The requested place already inside the centre reticle.
A place card open.
A route or delivery boundary drawn on the map.

arrangements.text: The map fills the task area, with the reticle at its centre, search along the top edge, and zoom controls in the upper-left corner.
Search sits to the left of the map, while the reticle stays at the map's centre and zoom controls sit in its upper-right corner.

scenarios.name: zoom
scenarios.screen: The map shows roads, geographic features, district names, and the place markers visible at its starting level. Zoom controls and search are visible; the requested place is unselected and no place card is open.
never: The requested place already selected.
A place card open.
Every small place label displayed regardless of zoom level.

arrangements.text: The map fills the task area, with search along its top edge and the plus and minus controls in its upper-left corner.
Search sits to the left of the map, and the plus and minus controls sit in the map's upper-right corner.

scenarios.name: pin
scenarios.screen: The map shows roads, geographic features, district names, and visible place markers. A place or address search and pin-editing controls are visible; the search is empty, its suggestions are closed, and no pin has been placed.
never: A dropped pin already on the map.
An open search suggestion list.
A route or closed delivery boundary drawn on the map.

arrangements.text: The map fills the task area, with search and pin controls above it and zoom controls in its upper-left corner.
Search and pin controls sit to the left of the map, with zoom controls in the map's upper-right corner.

scenarios.name: route
scenarios.screen: The map shows roads, geographic features, district names, and visible place markers. An ordered set of numbered waypoint handles and map controls is visible; no waypoint has been placed and no route is drawn.
never: A waypoint already placed on a destination.
A route line already connecting stops.
A closed delivery polygon.

arrangements.text: The numbered waypoint handles sit beside the left edge of the map, with zoom controls in the map's upper-left corner.
The numbered waypoint handles sit below the map in visit order, with zoom controls in the map's upper-right corner.

scenarios.name: zone
scenarios.screen: The map shows roads, geographic features, district names, and visible places or addresses. Zone editing controls are visible; the vertex list is empty and no delivery boundary or filled area is drawn.
never: A polygon vertex already placed.
A closed or filled delivery area.
A route line connecting numbered stops.

arrangements.text: The map fills the task area, with zone editing controls to its left and zoom controls in its upper-left corner.
Zone editing controls sit below the map, with zoom controls in the map's upper-right corner.

scenarios.name: zoomto
scenarios.screen: The map shows roads, geographic features, district names, and place markers visible at its starting level. Search and zoom controls are visible; the requested place is away from the map centre and no place card is open.
never: The requested place already centred at the requested level.
A place card open.
A dropped pin or route line on the map.

arrangements.text: The map fills the task area, with search along its top edge and zoom controls in its upper-left corner.
Search sits to the left of the map, with zoom controls in the map's upper-right corner.
